Name: Red's Dog Reskins
Author: magimatica
Description:
I picked dog for the first time in my latest file. So here are brindled pit bull, yellow lab, chocolate lab, and black lab dog reskins.

xnb v2: Now with golden retriever, red setter, and semi-transparent grim!

xnb v3: Now with two more pit bulls! I recently learned that lovers of pit bulls call them 'pibbles' and I think that is the cutest thing.

[b]Update 8/4/18: CP v1[/b]
This mod has been updated and repackaged for use with ContentPatcher! This version also replaces the dog face icon in the menu to match the dog you choose. You can still download the xnb version as an optional file.

[b]Update 01/31/21: CP v1.1[/b]
Updated for 1.5, now compatible with the 3 dog choices.

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]To change which breed of dog you have, just change the breed name in the config.json file!
[/list]
[/code]
